title: Near-MDS codes of lengths q+6 and q+7 from conics in PG(2,q), q odd
summary: Near maximum distance separable (NMDS) codes of dimension 3 and length n over the finite field with q elements are equivalent to (n,3)-arcs in PG(2,q). For every odd prime power q we construct, by adding five suitable points to a conic of PG(2,q), a family of [q+6,3,q+3] NMDS codes and determine their weight distributions completely; three distinct weight enumerators occur, governed by two explicit quadratic-character conditions on the parameters. For every odd prime power q, no code of our family is monomially equivalent to a code of the recent [q+6,3,q+3] NMDS family of Fan, Wang and Xu,…
